reviews.text: Great Facility and Super friendly and knowledgeable staff. Highly Recommend!

kind and caring staff and vets.  They provide options rather than just quote the most expensive treatment.  Full service including food, pharmacy, nail clipping, etc. A tad on the expensive side but I think most vetinarian practices are!

I walked in, checked inbat the front desk and, before I even had a chance to sit down, I was directed straight into a waiting area. That alone impressed me! All of the paperwork had already been completed at home online (on my phone) before making my appointment, which made the entire process even smoother.

I brought my last guinea pig here; Floof-Floof. She is a very old lady, (about 8 years old) and the staff treated her so gently and with so much care. A growth was noticed so I needed a good vet who's knowledgeable with piggies.

The doctor was very professional, kind, and transparent. While it does make me sad that the diagnosis may be grim, (cancer) I truly appreciated the honesty, and the situation was actually better than what I had been fearing. She was given medication to help with arthritis.

We are still waiting for her biopsy results, but so far I have been very happy with the experience.

The prices were also reasonable and fair, especially for exotic animal care. I would definitely recommend and come back!
I've been going to this place for years, and they always take excellent care of my bird. The front staff is kind and welcoming, and the doctors are patient and gentle. Highly recommended!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR CHAMELEON HERE*****

I strongly recommend that chameleon owners seek a veterinarian with specific experience treating chameleons before choosing this facility.

I brought my chameleon here twice, and unfortunately, neither experience gave me confidence in the level of specialized care provided.

During my first visit in 2025, I paid $160 and was told my chameleon was healthy despite an existing issue with his eye. I was told surgery was an option, but that the issue could return, and that it was okay to leave it alone if it wasn’t affecting his eating.

I returned for a second visit when the same eye became infected. The same veterinarian examined him and applied what I felt was excessive pressure around his eye. After bringing him home, his eye was bleeding, significantly swollen, remained closed, and developed persistent discharge. His other eye eventually began having issues as well.

I contacted the facility and spoke with another veterinarian, Melissa, but I felt my concerns were dismissed. I declined to return to the same veterinarian and ultimately sought care elsewhere.

I was also charged another $160 for the second visit. I found this difficult to justify considering the limited examination and care provided.

I also had negative experiences with the front desk, including what I felt was passive-aggressive and unprofessional behavior.

Most importantly, after seeking another veterinarian and doing additional research, I learned about concerns regarding my chameleon’s weight, diet, and swollen back legs that had never been discussed during either visit. I had repeatedly been told he was healthy.

I understand that exotic animals can be difficult to diagnose, and no veterinarian can guarantee an outcome. However, if a facility treats chameleons, I believe owners should be able to expect appropriate species-specific knowledge and care.

Based on my experience, I strongly recommend researching a veterinarian’s specific experience with chameleons before bringing your pet here.

Great staff! Very informative, and gentle. Answered every one of my questions and addressed every concern that I had. On top of that I found the price was reasonable for a reptile.

The clinic is good overall, but there's a big downside. They don't respond and ignore requests for me to obtain medical records for my budgie. It left a negative aftertaste, like specialists who didn't care about my parrot when it was in an emergency.
Dr. Wilson is the best, thoughtful and extremely knowledgeable. never tries to upsell you on anything. Deeply cares about her patients. Had a great experience here!

Unfortunately, it’s the only place for exotic animals in New York and Yonkers. I’ve already tried more than three times to schedule an appointment, but they never answer the phone, even when I leave a voicemail. So I recommend looking for another place because I don’t see any way to get an appointment with them.
